priorities.name: Structured B.C. economic and adoption data
priorities.rationale: Highest-value official sources with repeatable machine-readable acquisition routes.

priorities.name: B.C. energy supply and electricity system data
priorities.rationale: Core inputs for load, supply, trade and industrial-demand modelling.

priorities.name: Regulatory planning assumptions
priorities.rationale: Authoritative but document-intensive assumptions requiring evidence extraction and review.

priorities.name: Technology and adoption assumptions
priorities.rationale: Scenario and cost inputs that require explicit geography, dollar year and technology scope.

priorities.name: Project-event derived variables
priorities.rationale: Realization rates and lead times should be calculated from longitudinal project histories.

excluded_variables.reason: Removed from scope at user direction.

additional_variables_to_register.rationale: Available from the existing labour-force table and adapter.
Available from the existing labour-force table and adapter.

bc_stats_households.notes: Use province-level region rows and retain estimate/projection, vintage and scenario fields.

icbc_vehicle_population.notes: Separate BEV, PHEV and hybrid; retain vehicle class, model year, geography and registration year.

bc_energy_regulator_production.notes: Aggregate well-level production by production month; distinguish raw gas and marketable gas.

cer_electricity_trade.notes: Current collector provides Canada totals and western prices. Add province-specific volumes only when the source explicitly identifies B.C.

bc_hydro_planning.notes: Prioritize annual sales, peak demand, generation, imports, DSM and forecast vintages.

bcuc_filings.publisher: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities
bcuc_filings.notes: Preserve proceeding, exhibit, page, table, scenario and review decision.

nrcan_energy_use.notes: Existing collector covers B.C. heat-pump and electric heating system stock.

nrel_atb.notes: Retain technology, scenario, target year, currency conversion and real-dollar basis; do not present as B.C.-observed costs.

cer_energy_futures.notes: Suitable for national/provincial scenario variables where exact definitions are available.

iea_critical_minerals.notes: Store named mineral, technology demand, scenario, target year and source unit.

bc_project_events.publisher: Government of British Columbia, Impact Assessment Agency of Canada and project proponents
bc_project_events.notes: Build project-stage histories before calculating realization rates or construction lead times.

variables.name: Household growth
variables.description: Percentage change in the estimated or projected number of private households from the preceding year.

variables.name: Households
variables.description: Estimated or projected number of private households in British Columbia; collective dwellings excluded.
variables.publication_gate: Validate province-level region codes, vintage and estimate/projection distinction.
variables.source_series_scope: Province of B.C.; occupied private households; estimate or projection explicitly identified.

variables.name: Brent oil price
variables.description: Europe Brent spot price.

variables.name: Copper price
variables.description: Specified copper benchmark price, with benchmark, market, frequency and real or nominal price basis retained in source metadata.

variables.name: Henry Hub natural gas price
variables.description: Henry Hub natural gas spot price for the stated reference period.

variables.name: Japan LNG import price proxy
variables.description: World Bank monthly Japan LNG import price series. This is a public proxy and is not Platts JKM.

variables.name: Mid-Columbia electricity price assumption
variables.description: Average Mid-Columbia wholesale electricity price assumption used by the named decision maker.

variables.name: Sumas natural-gas price assumption
variables.description: Average Sumas natural-gas price assumption used by the named decision maker.

variables.name: WTI oil price
variables.description: Cushing, Oklahoma West Texas Intermediate spot price.

variables.name: Electricity load growth rate
variables.description: Compound annual growth rate in annual electricity demand over the stated forecast interval.

variables.name: Utility electricity demand forecast
variables.description: Electricity demand or sales forecast for the named utility, service territory, scenario, target period and vintage.

variables.name: Utility electricity sales
variables.description: Electricity sales for the named utility and service territory, retaining quarterly, year-to-date or annual basis in metadata.

variables.name: Utility natural-gas sales
variables.description: Natural-gas sales for the named utility and service territory, retaining quarterly, year-to-date or annual basis in metadata.

variables.name: All-items CPI index
variables.description: Monthly all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

variables.name: Annual housing starts
variables.description: Observed or forecast total housing starts over a calendar year in British Columbia; distinct from monthly SAAR measures.

variables.name: Bank of Canada target overnight rate
variables.description: Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate on the reference date.

variables.name: CAD per USD exchange rate
variables.description: Daily average Canadian-dollar value of one United States dollar.

variables.name: Construction inflation
variables.description: Year-over-year percentage change in the Statistics Canada Building Construction Price Index for aggregate non-residential construction in Vancouver.

variables.name: Employment
variables.description: Seasonally adjusted number of employed persons aged 15 years and over in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

variables.name: Employment growth
variables.description: Percentage change in seasonally adjusted employment from the same month one year earlier.

variables.name: Government of Canada 10-year benchmark yield
variables.description: Daily yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond.

variables.name: Housing completions in centres of 10,000 and over
variables.description: Monthly housing completions in British Columbia population centres of 10,000 and over; not a full provincial total.

variables.name: Housing starts (SAAR)
variables.description: CMHC housing starts in British Columbia, seasonally adjusted at an annual rate, for the reference month.

variables.name: Housing starts growth (SAAR)
variables.description: Percentage change in British Columbia total housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate from the same month one year earlier.

variables.name: Housing units under construction in centres of 10,000 and over
variables.description: Month-end housing units under construction in British Columbia population centres of 10,000 and over; not a full provincial total.

variables.name: Inflation
variables.description: Year-over-year percentage change in the all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

variables.name: Labour force
variables.description: Seasonally adjusted number of persons aged 15 years and over in the labour force in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

variables.name: Labour force growth
variables.description: Percentage change in the seasonally adjusted labour force from the same month one year earlier.

variables.name: Labour force participation rate
variables.description: Labour force participation rate for the stated geography, age and sex scope, period, source and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Nominal GDP growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in nominal gross domestic product for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Population
variables.description: Estimated resident population of British Columbia at the reference date.

variables.name: Population growth
variables.description: Percentage change in the estimated resident population of British Columbia from the same reference period one year earlier.

variables.name: Real GDP growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in real gross domestic product for British Columbia.

variables.name: Real exports growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in real exports of goods and services for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Retail sales growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in nominal retail sales for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Unemployment rate
variables.description: Unemployment rate for the stated geography, population scope, period, source and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Vancouver non-residential construction price index
variables.description: Quarterly aggregate non-residential building construction price index for Vancouver.

variables.name: Residential electric heating-system stock
variables.description: NRCan estimate of electric residential heating systems in British Columbia, excluding the separately identified heat-pump category.

variables.name: Residential heat-pump heating-system stock
variables.description: NRCan estimate of residential heat-pump heating systems in British Columbia.

variables.name: Residential heat-pump share
variables.description: NRCan estimate of heat pumps as a share of residential heating-system stock in British Columbia.

variables.name: B.C. marketable natural-gas production
variables.description: Monthly British Columbia marketable natural-gas production published by the Canada Energy Regulator.

variables.name: Allowed return on equity
variables.description: Regulator-approved return on equity for a named utility and decision context.

variables.name: Deemed common-equity share
variables.description: Regulator-approved deemed common-equity share for a named utility and decision context.

variables.name: Long-term interest-rate assumption
variables.description: Long-term Canadian interest-rate assumption used in a named public-sector or utility decision context.

variables.name: Pension and post-employment-benefit discount rate
variables.description: Accounting discount-rate assumption used for pension or other post-employment-benefit expense; context must be retained and it must not be treated as a project discount rate.

variables.name: Short-term interest-rate assumption
variables.description: Short-term Canadian interest-rate assumption used in a named public-sector or utility decision context.

variables.name: Social discount rate
variables.description: Real social discount rate prescribed or recommended for a named public policy or benefit-cost decision context. This is a non-temporal parameter and must retain its publication, effective and decision context.

variables.name: Canadian electricity export value
variables.description: Monthly value of international electricity exports from Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

variables.name: Canadian electricity exports
variables.description: Monthly international electricity exports from Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

variables.name: Canadian electricity import value
variables.description: Monthly value of international electricity imports to Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

variables.name: Canadian electricity imports
variables.description: Monthly international electricity imports to Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

variables.name: Western Canada electricity export price
variables.description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity export price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

variables.name: Western Canada electricity import price
variables.description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity import price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

variables.name: Incremental electricity load from fuel switching
variables.description: Incremental electricity demand attributed to a named fuel-switching or electrification driver, scenario, target year and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Independent power and long-term purchases
variables.description: Electricity purchased from independent power producers and long-term contracts by the named utility.

variables.name: Line losses and system use
variables.description: Electricity attributed to line losses and internal system use for the named utility.

variables.name: System water inflows relative to average
variables.description: Forecast or observed water inflows for the named hydroelectric utility as a percentage of its planning average.

variables.name: Thermal and other generation
variables.description: Thermal and other electricity generation for the named utility.

variables.name: Total utility load and system exports
variables.description: Domestic sales, system exports, line losses and system use for the named utility.

variables.name: Utility actual capital expenditure
variables.description: Actual capital expenditure or property, plant and equipment additions for the named utility and stated reporting basis.

variables.name: Utility capital expenditure forecast
variables.description: Forecast capital expenditure for the named utility, target period and filing vintage.

variables.name: Utility customer count
variables.description: Actual or forecast customer count for the named utility and service territory.

variables.name: Utility customer growth
variables.description: Actual or forecast annual customer-count growth for the named utility and service territory.

variables.name: Utility domestic generation
variables.description: Electricity generated by the named utility within the stated service or reporting scope.

variables.name: Utility natural-gas cost
variables.description: Natural-gas commodity, transport or storage cost for the named gas utility and stated reporting period, with scope retained in metadata.

variables.name: Utility power-purchase cost
variables.description: Power-purchase cost for the named electric utility and stated reporting period.

variables.name: Utility rate base
variables.description: Actual, approved or forecast average rate base for the named regulated utility.

variables.name: Utility system exports
variables.description: Electricity exported by the named utility in the stated period and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Utility system imports
variables.description: Electricity imports assumed or observed for the named utility.

variables.name: AECO natural gas price
variables.description: Specified AECO or Alberta NIT benchmark, with product, delivery period and administrator retained in metadata.
variables.publication_gate: Do not publish proprietary benchmark values without explicit rights.
alternative_sources: NGX or price administrator data subject to redistribution rights

variables.name: EV stock
variables.description: Registered in-use light-duty or total electric vehicles, with vehicle and powertrain scope specified.
variables.publication_gate: Confirm propulsion and vehicle-class definitions and ICBC licence attribution.
variables.source_series_scope: Registered in-use vehicles; publish BEV and PHEV separately and optionally a combined plug-in total.

variables.name: EV stock growth
variables.description: Year-over-year percentage change in the defined electric-vehicle stock.

variables.name: Reservoir inflows
variables.description: Observed or assumed inflow volume or normalized index for a named reservoir system and period.
alternative_sources: Water Survey of Canada station aggregation

variables.name: Snowpack assumption
variables.description: Snow-water-equivalent index as a percentage of normal for a named basin and bulletin date.
alternative_sources: B.C. Snow Survey and Water Supply Bulletin
variables.notes: User previously asked not to prioritize River Forecast Centre collection; retain as lower-priority alternative only.

variables.name: Electricity import cost
variables.description: Observed or assumed electricity import cost, including market, delivery point, currency and price basis.
variables.publication_gate: Distinguish observed trade value per MWh from planning import-price assumptions.

variables.name: Cost of debt
variables.description: Embedded, forecast or allowed cost of debt, with issuer, regulatory treatment and period specified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: Cost of equity
variables.description: Forecast or allowed return on equity, with methodology, capital structure and period specified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: Discount rate
variables.description: Legacy generic discount-rate variable retained for compatibility. New records should use social, utility-regulatory or pension discount-rate variables and preserve the named decision context.
alternative_sources: Treasury Board of Canada cost-benefit guidance
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: WACC
variables.description: Nominal or real weighted average cost of capital, before or after tax as explicitly identified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: ELCC assumption
variables.description: Effective load-carrying capability as a share of nameplate capacity for a defined resource, duration, penetration level, system and target year.
variables.publication_gate: Require resource, duration, penetration, system, target year and methodology.

variables.name: Import energy availability
variables.description: Energy available for import over a defined period and under a named market, hydrological or reliability condition.

variables.name: Reserve margin
variables.description: Planning reserve margin for a defined system, season, planning year and capacity-accreditation convention.

variables.name: Drought recurrence
variables.description: Return period or scenario frequency for a precisely defined drought event and basin.
variables.publication_gate: Store event definition and basin; do not mix scenario recurrence with observed return periods.

variables.name: Critical mineral demand
variables.description: Demand for a named mineral under a named scenario, expressed in physical units or an index; mineral and end use are required dimensions.

variables.name: Building electrification rate
variables.description: Annual share of the specified building stock converting a named end use from fossil fuel to electricity.
variables.publication_gate: Define stock denominator and fuel-switching event; calculate from stock transitions where possible.
alternative_sources: BC Hydro conservation and electrification filings

variables.name: Heat pump installed cost
variables.description: Installed cost for a defined heat-pump type and building archetype, with rebate, tax, electrical-upgrade and dollar-year treatment specified.
variables.publication_gate: Retain equipment type, building archetype, rebates, electrical upgrades and dollar year.
alternative_sources: CleanBC program evaluation and rebate application data
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: AI compute growth
variables.description: Annual growth in a specified measure of AI training or inference compute, with scope and denominator retained.

variables.name: Data centre power intensity
variables.description: Electrical demand per defined unit of data-centre capacity or floor area; denominator and load convention are required.
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: Transformer lead times
variables.description: Elapsed time from order to delivery for a specified transformer class and procurement market.
alternative_sources: U.S. Department of Energy transformer supply-chain reports
variables.preferred_source_name: British Columbia Utilities Commission and regulated utilities

variables.name: Battery cost curve
variables.description: Installed battery-system cost for a defined chemistry, duration, power/energy basis, scenario, target year and dollar year.

variables.name: Hydrogen cost curve
variables.description: Levelized hydrogen production cost for a defined production pathway, electricity price, utilization, scenario, region and dollar year.
alternative_sources: U.S. Department of Energy Hydrogen Program

variables.name: Solar cost curve
variables.description: Capital cost for a defined solar technology, scale, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.

variables.name: Wind cost curve
variables.description: Capital cost for a defined wind technology, resource class, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.

variables.name: Data centre realization rate
variables.description: Derived probability that a data-centre proposal at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.
alternative_sources: BC Hydro connection and call-for-power records where public
variables.preferred_source_name: Government of British Columbia, Impact Assessment Agency of Canada and project proponents

variables.name: LNG realization rate
variables.description: Derived probability that a project at a defined development stage reaches a defined realized stage within a stated time horizon.
variables.preferred_source_name: Government of British Columbia, Impact Assessment Agency of Canada and project proponents

variables.name: Mining realization rate
variables.description: Derived probability that a mining project at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.
variables.preferred_source_name: Government of British Columbia, Impact Assessment Agency of Canada and project proponents

variables.name: Construction lead times
variables.description: Elapsed time between defined project milestones for a named infrastructure class.
variables.preferred_source_name: Government of British Columbia, Impact Assessment Agency of Canada and project proponents

variables.name: LNG price (JKM)
variables.description: Platts Japan Korea Marker price or a clearly labelled public proxy; proprietary JKM values must not be republished without suitable rights.

variables.name: Annual electricity demand
variables.description: Annual electrical energy demand for a defined system, customer scope and weather-treatment basis.

variables.name: Utility peak demand
variables.description: Peak system demand for the named utility, service territory, measurement interval and period.

variables.name: Utility peak-demand forecast
variables.description: Peak-demand forecast for the named utility, service territory, scenario, target period and vintage.

variables.name: Labour productivity growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in labour productivity under the stated definition, source and scenario.

variables.name: Real imports growth
variables.description: Annual percentage change in real imports of goods and services for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

variables.name: Battery-electric vehicle stock
variables.description: Registered battery-electric vehicle stock in B.C. under the configured ICBC geography and vehicle-class scope.

variables.name: Battery-electric vehicle stock growth
variables.description: Annual percentage growth in registered B.C. battery-electric vehicle stock under a consistent ICBC scope.

variables.name: Plug-in hybrid vehicle stock
variables.description: Registered plug-in hybrid vehicle stock in B.C. under the configured ICBC geography and vehicle-class scope.

variables.name: Plug-in hybrid vehicle stock growth
variables.description: Annual percentage growth in registered B.C. plug-in hybrid vehicle stock under a consistent ICBC scope.

variables.name: Residential natural-gas heating-system stock
variables.description: Combined NRCan estimate of medium- and high-efficiency natural-gas residential heating systems in British Columbia.

variables.name: B.C. gross reported natural-gas production
variables.description: Monthly sum of gross reported gas production in the BCER bulk archive; not equivalent to marketable production.

variables.name: Utility regulatory discount rate
variables.description: Discount rate used for a named utility regulatory calculation. This is a non-temporal parameter; it must not be confused with allowed ROE, WACC, cost of debt or pension discount rates.

variables.name: Utility capacity gap
variables.description: Forecast dependable-capacity requirement or supply gap for the named utility, scenario, target period and vintage.

variables.name: Utility demand-side management savings
variables.description: Actual or forecast annual energy savings attributed to utility demand-side management.

variables.name: Utility electricity trade income
variables.description: Actual or forecast trade income for the named utility and reporting period.

variables.name: Utility energy supply gap
variables.description: Forecast firm-energy requirement or supply gap for the named utility, scenario, target period and vintage.

variables.name: Utility market purchases
variables.description: Electricity market purchases for the named utility and stated period.

variables.name: Utility rate change
variables.description: Proposed, interim or approved utility rate change for the named utility, service and effective period.

variables.name: Utility system loss-rate assumption
variables.description: Electricity or gas system loss-rate assumption used by the named utility in the stated planning or rate context.
